name: Risala
why_it_matters: Inside Taj Umaid Bhawan Palace — the third-largest private residence in the world, home of the Jodhpur royal family. Risala's recipes are drawn from the palace's actual royal kitchens; art-deco dining room with garden + Mehrangarh sightlines.
insider_tip: Open to non-resident diners but car access via the back gate, not the front lobby. Combine dinner with the Trophy Bar (in-house) for one of the few public-access cocktail venues inside Umaid Bhawan.
signature_address: Umaid Bhawan Palace, Circuit House Road, Cantt Area, Jodhpur 342006

name: Jodhpur Cafe (Ajit Bhawan)
why_it_matters: Inside Ajit Bhawan, India's first heritage hotel (1927 palace of Maharadhiraj Sir Ajit Singhji, Maharaja Umaid Singh's younger brother). Multi-cuisine with one of Jodhpur's only vegan-friendly menus; sister kitchens to the Garden Restaurant + Dhani thali venue on the same property.
insider_tip: For the full-Marwar village experience, book the Dhani Restaurant (dinner-only on the property) instead — same kitchen, mud-hut setting with folk performance. Jodhpur Cafe is the better daytime option.
signature_address: Ajit Bhawan, Near Circuit House, Airforce Area, Jodhpur 342006

name: On The Rocks
why_it_matters: Standalone garden restaurant next to Ajit Bhawan, opened 1995 — Jodhpur's longest-running standalone (non-hotel) multi-cuisine address. Three zones: Rocktail Bar, Curry Kitchen, Machan tree-house seating.
insider_tip: Machan tree-house seats are first-come — arrive at 7pm or call in the booking. Live folk performances start around 8:30pm; the Rocktail Bar side is quieter if you want to talk.
signature_address: Near Ajit Bhawan, Circuit House Road, Cantt Area, Jodhpur 342006
